svg.title: 03 Research synthesis
svg.desc: What did the research find, how strong is each finding and which decisions did it drive? Decisions fed: D-03, D-04, D-06. Status: Draft. Reconstructed for portfolio purposes; illustrative.

text.tspan: Question: What did the research find, how strong is each finding and which decisions did it drive?

svg.text: Feeds: D-03, D-04, D-06 | Status: Draft

text.tspan: I decided: The codebook structure, the ordinal evidence rubric instead of tallies and which themes
We built: The coding, two coders per source, the affinity sessions and the evidence table. Theme
names were argued out in the weekly coding review.

svg.text: AFFINITY MAP: CODED OBSERVATIONS CLUSTERED INTO THIRTEEN THEMES. CARDS CARRY A PARAPHRASED OBSERVATION AND ITS METHOD TAGS. NO TALLIES.

text.tspan: Three systems opened to find one
Request chased twice before the week
Restart the trace after a client call
Tracing a sample to its documents
Same five fields compared, item after
The matching is the part I would give
No reachable source, sent back unread
Re-performable from the file or not
Notes are about references, not calls
Three days waiting for the manager
Note cleared, reopened by the partner
lives and nobody hands that off
Flagging is easy, deciding is mine
Call the controller about the cutoff
agent read and rejecting one step
Show me the page it read
Let me redo one step with the right
A number alone is not confidence
If it is wrong it is still my name
Would rather not use it than not know
The signer wants the exception trail
Teams want the system to enforce
That file cannot leave the client
Better that it refuses than I remember
Senior re-walks the sample for the
What is open lives in my head
Day two starts with re-explaining day
Fewer clicks, I know the procedure
Guidance in the way during peak
Two columns added, one dropped, every
Make the structure fit, not the team

svg.text: consistency rating from the rubric in findings.md

Reconstructed. Every finding here is a reconstruction of what the research found, rated by an ordinal rubric. No observation, participant or quote count appears because every n except the dry run is a planned target.
